capabilities: Render a procon code block as editable pro/con argument cards
Set argument weights by clicking symbols such as stars or flames
Show a result bar splitting total weight between pro and con
Add, rename, reorder, move and delete arguments without editing table syntax
Choose between Colored and Plain designs and six weight symbols
extras: README states the plugin makes no network requests and collects no data; requires Obsidian 1.4.0 or newer on desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to weigh pro and con arguments of a decision inside a note.
summary: Decision helper that renders a Markdown table of weighted pro and con arguments as editable cards with a result bar.
